product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native supply-chain planning, modeling, and decision-intelligence platform for large enterprises managing complex supply chains.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation/footer has no public pricing page, and the /pricing URL only returns a permanent redirect rather than pricing information.

named_customers.notes: Both are named on Lyric’s customer-stories and clients/case-studies pages.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 323 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

founded_year.notes: The company information page states that Lyric was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The index identifies one clearly engineering-authored engineering-insights post. Other technical articles include a post by the founder/CEO, but the available bylines do not establish a second engineer-authored post.

public_docs.notes: The documentation site presents an email login gate rather than several publicly accessible product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Nov. 9 inventory lists Lyric as hiring for an ML engineering role, and the linked Lyric posting is titled ML (Data) Platform Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Lyric describes supply-chain-native models and names infrastructure/subprocessors, but the reviewed public product, AI, and security materials do not name an AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed as SOC 2 Type 2 attested, ISO/IEC 27001 certified, and aligned with GDPR; only requested named items are included.

last_funding.notes: Lyric’s current official information page reports a $55.5M Series B; its dated Aug. 5, 2025 announcement initially reported $43.5M for that round. I use the current official amount and the dated announcement for the month.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced on Aug. 5, 2025, within the 18 months before Nov. 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lyric’s live Ashby posting is for an Enterprise Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable recent index shows analyst mentions, thought leadership, and an article about agents and forecasting, but no dated product or major-feature launch announcement in the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sean Zonneveld’s profile lists an EVP Global Sales role at Lyric starting May 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Lyric GTM job post explicitly lists Salesforce in its GTM tech stack.
